Messages.Author: Archibald Zimonyi
Messages.Body:
Hi all,

does "since your last turn" also include this turn?

Example:

1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5

If during 4's turn an ally has been burned, and 2 plays Resurrection
then this is included "since your last turn". But what happens if the
ally owned by 4 is burned in player 2's current turn.

Is the "last turn" bit cancelled as soon as your current turn begins
or does the "last turn" start when the current turn ends?

I would say the second part as otherwise Action cards with this text
would never be able to be played or am I just too tired to read
english correctly.

Archie

PS. No responses from Hugh please, as you would only say my fish is
not working correctly.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Archibald Zimonyi wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> does "since your last turn" also include this turn?

This turn is

1) Not your last turn
2) Not before your last turn

So, yes.

> Example:
>
> 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5
>
> If during 4's turn an ally has been burned, and 2 plays Resurrection
> then this is included "since your last turn". But what happens if the
> ally owned by 4 is burned in player 2's current turn.

2 can play Resurrection.

> Is the "last turn" bit cancelled as soon as your current turn begins
> or does the "last turn" start when the current turn ends?

The current "your turn" becomes "your last turn" when it ends (i.e., when the
next turn begins).

> I would say the second part as otherwise Action cards with this text
> would never be able to be played or am I just too tired to read
> english correctly.

Correct.
